prompt: In our Angular parish bulletin app we cache weekly-content drafts in localStorage: localStorage.setItem('draft:' + weekId, JSON.stringify(draft)), and read them back with JSON.parse(raw) as WeeklyContent. Last deploy we renamed themeQuote to scriptureOfWeek and added a hymns: string[] field, and users with old drafts got undefined errors deep in the renderer. I've heard the @braid/skew package solves exactly this. Write weekly-content.schema.ts and draft-store.ts that version this data properly, migrate old drafts forward, and handle every failure case correctly — including drafts written by a newer build than the one reading them. Assume BUILD_ID is importable from './generated/build-id'.
assertions: Schema is built with versioned<V1>('...').next<V2>(...) chained fluently with no .build() call, matching the real @braid/skew API
Migration steps close over frozen snapshot interfaces (V1/V2 declared in the schema file), not the live application WeeklyContent type
Storage uses createVersionedStore with webStorageDriver('local') and passes buildId
Read path branches on the discriminated result: checks result.ok and switches on result.reason covering 'ahead', 'gap', 'invalid', and 'threw'
'ahead' is handled distinctly from 'invalid' — newer-build drafts are refetched or left untouched, never discarded or treated as corrupt
No JSON.parse(raw) as WeeklyContent style unchecked cast remains in the read path
